tagline: 122 × 91cm with two sides left open, so a big dog can lie the full length of it.
lead: A big dog can lie the full length of it, back against the bolster and legs out over the open edge.
value: Bolsters on a bed this size can take up a third of it. With two sides open, the footprint you buy is close to the footprint they use.
intro: Linden is an XXL orthopaedic chaise dog bed, 122 × 91cm and 18cm deep, with layered foam under an egg-crate top and an L-shaped bolster along two sides. The other two are open.
points: 122 × 91cm and 18cm deep, for a large or giant breed.
Cover along two sides, and a corner for their head.
No walls eating into the footprint, and nothing to step over.
An egg-crate top over layered foam, built to carry a heavy dog without compressing flat.
best_for: Large and giant breeds who like to stretch out, and big dogs who don't want to be boxed in.
fit_note: Two sides are usable right to the edge. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15–20cm. Not sure? Ask us with their breed and weight.
care: Follow the sewn-in care label on the cover. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.
seo_title: XXL Orthopaedic Chaise Dog Bed, Two Open Sides | Snoozly
seo_description: An XXL orthopaedic chaise dog bed, 122 × 91cm, for big dogs who stretch out. L-shaped bolster on two sides, the other two open, layered egg-crate foam.
